expected_issues.title: Hardcoded Secrets in Source Code
expected_issues.message: ADMIN_TOKEN is hardcoded in source code, exposing a privileged credential if the repository is leaked or shared.
expected_issues.suggestion: Load secrets from environment variables or a secrets manager.

expected_issues.title: SQL Injection via f-string
expected_issues.message: User input is directly interpolated into SQL query using f-string, allowing SQL injection.
expected_issues.suggestion: Use parameterized queries instead of string interpolation.
expected_issues.resolution_example:
sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?"
db.query(sql, params=(username,))

expected_issues.title: Path Traversal via unsanitized filename
expected_issues.message: User-supplied filename is joined to BASE_DIR without validation, enabling path traversal attacks (e.g. '../../etc/passwd').
expected_issues.suggestion: Resolve the path and verify it starts with BASE_DIR before accessing.

expected_issues.title: Insecure Password Hashing (MD5)
expected_issues.message: MD5 is a cryptographically broken algorithm unsuitable for password hashing. It is vulnerable to brute-force and rainbow table attacks.
expected_issues.suggestion: Use bcrypt, argon2, or scrypt for password hashing.
expected_issues.resolution_example:
import bcrypt
salt = bcrypt.gensalt()
hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), salt)

expected_issues.title: Missing Authorization Check
expected_issues.message: delete_user_account does not verify whether the current user has permission to delete the target account, allowing any authenticated user to delete any account.
expected_issues.suggestion: Check that current_user_id matches target_user_id or that the user has admin privileges before deletion.
expected_issues.resolution_example:
if current_user_id != target_user_id and current_user_id not in self.admins:
    raise PermissionError('Not authorized')

ecommerce_custom_issues.message: SQL 문을 외부 입력과 동적으로 조합하고 있습니다 (SQL 인젝션 위험).
ecommerce_custom_issues.suggestion: 파라미터 바인딩(플레이스홀더)을 사용하세요. 사용자 입력을 SQL에 직접 넣지 마세요.

ecommerce_custom_issues.message: 사용자 입력 기반 파일 경로로 파일을 엽니다 (경로 탐색 위험). 영수증/송장 다운로드 주의.
ecommerce_custom_issues.suggestion: (BASE / name).resolve() 후 base 경로로 시작하는지 검증하세요.
